content.text: Rocket Lab Secures Largest-Ever Electron Commercial Deal: 20-Launch Contract for Synspective: Rocket Lab announced a signed agreement for 20 new dedicated Electron missions for Synspective, scheduled annually from 2028 through 2031 from Launch Complex 1 to sun-synchronous orbit. It called the deal its largest commercial Electron contract, said Synspective’s total Electron missions would reach 47, and reported launch backlog above 100 missions. The release says remaining deal terms are undisclosed. (time=2026-09-30T23:00:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
